# Unified architecture fixtures

`contract.json` freezes the P0 inputs and M07/M28 thresholds before product integration. Generated media, voices, fonts, models, credentials and private receipts stay outside Git. The text was authored for these synthetic fixtures; system voice/font resources are never copied into the bundle.

Run from `backend/` after `uv sync --project backend --frozen` at the repository root:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_unified_import.py tests/test_unified_fixtures.py tests/test_unified_media_fixture.py tests/test_unified_platform_preflight.py
```

The media test uses installed macOS `say` voices Kyoko/Tingting and the existing product FFmpeg selector with libass. Other platforms reuse the pinned generated bundle; a skipped macOS generator is not GPU acceptance. The permission probe requires an ordinary POSIX user and does not certify root, WSL mount semantics, reboot protection or a runtime Supervisor.

To retain a separate bundle, run from the repository root, choosing a **new** output directory whose parent exists:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=backend:backend/tests backend/.venv/bin/python -c 'from pathlib import Path; from unification_media import build_media; print(build_media(Path("/absolute/new/fixture")))'
```

`build_media` refuses an existing output. Failure leaves its partial files for inspection and does not write a final `manifest.json`. Each completed bundle pins file hashes, the contract hash, tool version, Arial font hash, RGB conversion, reference frames and exact commands with the fixture root redacted. The manifest is written last. It records preparation, never migration or product acceptance.

| Fixture | Contents and evidence boundary |
| --- | --- |
| F-media | 4501 frames, 30fps, 1280×720, synthetic Japanese/Chinese speech. Original scripts and translations are in the contract. The generated audio must be reviewed before ASR quality comparisons. |
| F-edit | 5000 unique cues at 30ms intervals, each lasting 20ms, a local style override and saved revision 1. The R2 media-backed sample includes a source proof generated by the existing reader. |
| F-live | Seven exactly 20s closed MP4 blocks plus a 7s tail, `closed.csv`, and an explicitly synthetic discontinuity mapping. AAC is re-encoded to avoid stream-copy duration drift. These are closed-block fixtures, not a capture/stop/recovery test. |
| F-state | Two externally identified Companion instances with the same old ID, malformed/missing/queued/failed/orphan cases, actual template/default/project files, protected fake credentials, and isolated R0/R1/R2 samples. Workstation JSON/SRT use the existing serialization functions and retain word timings; they are frozen format fixtures, not GPU results. |
| Expected | A five-second clip document with a one-to-three-second cue, ASS/SRT, transparent preview, FFV1 reference and seven fixed RGB frames. Fixed ROI: `(0,480,1280,240)`. FFV1 is only a reference; it cannot satisfy M28. |

`discover_companion(root, source_instance_id)` is the read-only P0 preflight slice of the future P5 importer. It never assigns an instance from a path, creates locks, copies tasks, writes mappings, seals roots or grants execution. Its `task_generation` covers task files only. It is **not** the activation `source_generation`, which must also bind global-package state and be rechecked under the future Supervisor. A terminal result only describes persisted observations; it does not prove that a writer has stopped. Running secondary translation/export records prevent a terminal classification.

Same-generation discovery equality is tested; persistent mapping idempotency, conflict resolution, prepare/verify/activate, cross-batch rollback, whole-set publication and independent recovery remain their P2–P5 gates. Original readers successfully loading fixture revisions does not certify the frozen recovery launcher. Keep all M01–M28 outcomes separate from fixture-preparation checks.

See the [execution record](../../../../docs/unified-architecture-execution-2026-10-22.md) and [Chinese counterpart](README.zh-CN.md).
